title: Moulton v. Kershaw — price quotation and quantity
shortTitle: Moulton v. Kershaw — price quotation and quantity
summary: The salt quotation illustrates the difference between inviting orders and committing to fill any responsive order.
notes: The quoted price and favorable language must be read with quantity, available supply, and the need for further assent. The notes ask how express limits or changed language would affect the characterization. The earlier Fairmount opinion is outside the assigned pages even though its concluding notes are included.
